question: Should v0.7.10 be published with the 2026-07-26 changelog date and the currently listed Slack Desktop cache-decoding fix?
rationale: Only the release owner can confirm the planned cut date and whether the versioned section is complete; source-level review and CI do not establish that release policy decision.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Keep the 2026-07-26 release date and merge once it matches the intended v0.7.10 publication record.

options.title: Adjust release metadata
options.body: Update the heading date or release contents before merge if the public cut differs from the prepared changelog entry.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Keep the 2026-07-26 release date and merge once it matches the intended v0.7.10 publication record.
